Name: Shout Calendar
Author: RifleJock
Punchline: Turns FFXIV chat invites into a month calendar you accept yourself.
Description:
Shout Calendar listens to the chats you choose and keeps event invites on a month calendar until you accept them. Nothing is accepted for you, and nothing is sent to other players.

It understands clocks, dates, today, tonight, tomorrow, next Tuesday, the Tuesday after next, every Tuesday, every other week, and the 1st and last Wednesday of a month. Places include wards, plots such as W3P26, coordinates, worlds, and names from the game's own data. A ward heard in a city guesses that city's housing district.

Save accepts a pending invite. Click a block to edit it under the month, or click the day number for that day's full list. Coordinates open the map with a flag. Known quest givers do the same, and quest names drop a quest link into chat.

The Resets tab adds Jumbo Cactpot, the weekly reset, and limited events such as A Nocturne for Heroes. Resets that share a clock share one line. Alarms play a chat sound from se.1 to se.16, or a WAV you choose. Colors are yours to set.

/shoutcalendar opens the calendar. /shoutcalendar test checks a line on your machine and does not send chat.
Changelog: The installer name is Shout Calendar. The window title is FFXIV Shout Calendar.
